items.title: Rotor System: Low-G and Mast Bumping
items.description: The two-blade teetering rotor's low inertia, FAA AD 95-26-04 on mast bumping and rotor stall, and the recovery technique that has to be automatic.

items.title: Governor: Throttle Correlator and RPM Control
items.description: How the friction-clutch governor and the collective-throttle correlator work, the liftoff overspeed trap, why both fade with altitude, how the governor hides carburetor ice, and the failure procedures.

items.title: Autorotation: Power Failure, Glide and Practice
items.description: Recognizing a power failure, the two glide configurations, restart, the flare and touchdown by height band, the height-velocity diagram, and the safety rules for practice autorotations.

items.title: Drive System: Belts, Clutch Light and Gearboxes
items.description: From the vee-belts and sprag clutch to the two gearboxes, the belt-slack and clutch-actuator checks, what the clutch light means after three seconds versus ten, chip lights, bearing noise and the rotor brake.

items.title: Limitations: Operating Limits by Phase of Flight
items.description: Weights and fuel on the ramp, dispatch items, gauge markings at start, the model-specific manifold pressure placards, rotor and engine speeds, VNE, and the wind and turbulence limits.
